notes: cta B : avant/après, slide 6, sur une image sans visage. Images prises dans toute la banque (règle du 12/11). full test. Accroche jamais faite chez nous. Les lignes 3 à 6 de la boîte sont sautées (faute de frappe dans l'accroche à reprendre mot pour mot), la boîte n'a que 10 lignes utilisables pour 11 déclinaisons, d'où un 6e full test. Accroches écrites : « Signs you're wasting your potential » (retenue), « You're capable of much more » (écartée : sans promesse), « How to stop wasting your talent » (écartée : plus faible).

slides.texte_overlay: You keep saying "one day." One day I'll train, one day I'll travel, one day I'll start. Potential gets wasted in the gap between plans and action.
Your evenings disappear into your phone. Three hours a night is over a thousand hours a year. That's enough time to learn almost any skill.
You're the smartest person in your circle. If nobody around you pushes you, you stop growing. Find people who are a few steps ahead.
You avoid anything you might fail at. Fear of looking bad keeps you in safe, small routines. Growth always starts with being a beginner.
Before: I knew I could do more but did nothing. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and I finally feel myself growing again.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: I knew I could do more but did nothing. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. I finally feel myself growing again.

slides.texte_overlay: You start things but never finish them. Ten half-done projects prove nothing. One finished project changes how you see yourself.
You know exactly what you should do. That's the good news. Pick the first small step and do it today, not tomorrow. Small steps beat perfect plans.
